text:
Perot finished with about 19% of the popular vote in the 1992 election, roughly 19.7 million votes, and won no electoral votes. The team note saying he ended well under ten percent is wrong. That figure is far below his actual result, which was one of the strongest third-party showings in modern U.S. history. His support did fall from the 39% June peak after he withdrew in July and re-entered in October.

CONFIDENCE: 97
